title: 耶鲁Joyce：硅谷领袖为何集体反思——问题在后果而非行为？
speaker: Joyce

segments.en: The deeper problem is I think the lesson being learned that you see more and more people on Silicon Valley sort of tweeting out over and over again Well the problem here
segments.zh: 更深层的问题在于，我认为人们正在吸取的教训是，你看到越来越多硅谷的人反复发推说，问题在于

segments.en: I'm going to quote povl duro from telegram here. The problem was that he had a board Right as if the issue was that what like the most sympathetic thing you can possibly say about Jensen Huang right is still that he engaged in behaviors
segments.zh: 我引用Telegram上Povl Duro的话。问题在于他有一个董事会，就好像问题在于，你对黄仁勋最同情的话仍然是，他参与了某些行为

segments.en: That were in massive violation of Nvidia rules like maybe you should have been fired whatever we can have that discussion But there's no argument that he wasn't in massive violation of their code of conduct
segments.zh: 这些行为严重违反了英伟达的规定，也许你该被解雇，随便吧，我们可以讨论这个，但无可辩驳的是，他严重违反了他们的行为准则

segments.en: um Somehow a lot of leaders in Silicon Valley have come to the conclusion of the problem here Was that he faced consequences for the conduct not the conduct itself
segments.zh: 不知怎的，硅谷许多领导者得出的结论是，问题在于他因行为而面临后果，而不是行为本身

segments.en: That's a remarkable place for them But what do you do about that because that seems to be the prevailing wisdom or thought among this small group of mainly men who are running these companies
segments.zh: 这对他们来说是个了不起的立场，但你该怎么办呢？因为这似乎是这个主要由男性组成的小团体中的普遍智慧或想法，他们经营着这些公司

segments.en: And whose behavior until recently has gone largely unchecked. They're all defending each other
segments.zh: 直到最近，他们的行为基本上不受约束。他们都在互相辩护
